messages:
Pranav: heads up, ran the new starter (next app-router + edge runtime + LlamaClient) and hit flaky 401s when testing on Vercel preview.
Pranav: dev: everything fine. preview deploy: sporadic failures on the first request after deploy, then works.
Eli: that sounds like an auth handshake gap. do you have request logs?
Pranav: pasted the minimal trace in the starter issue. snippet: `fetch("https://api.redwood/auth/refresh", { method: 'POST', credentials: 'omit' }) -> 401`
Pranav: interestingly the SDK's node path will attempt refresh+retry but the edge adapter returns the 401 up the stack without retry.
Maria: is the token coming from Vercel env or from the serverless function?
Pranav: we mint short-lived tokens during preview from the serverless API route, then pass them into the client bundled for edge; seems the edge bundle loses the retry shim.
DevEx Bot: Note: existing workaround documented in internal KB: use server-side refresh endpoint and let client call it on 401. Link: https://intranet.redwood/edge-refresh-workaround
Eli: ok, proposed path: (A) patch edge adapter to implement the same single-request-solo refresh mutex used in node, (B) add an opt-in compatibility flag `EDGE_REFRESH_DEFER=1` for starters that toggles behavior until we release patch.
Kevin: also add telemetry event `edge_auth_retry` so we can count occurrences from preview deploys.
Sam: and add a preroll e2e: PRs that change starter templates run a lightweight vercel-preview smoke that hits `/api/ping` and `/api/generate` to catch auth regressions.
Pranav: I can add a repro example in the starter repo and link to the failing preview. opened issue: https://git.redwood/monorepo-starter/issues/57
Eli: assigned to me. I'll implement the mutex + retry and a unit test mocking `fetch` returning 401 then 200.
Maria: for short-term DX, let's add a clear note in the starter README titled "Preview deploy quirks (Vercel Edge)" with the env flag and the workaround snippet: ```js
// workaround: force server refresh on 401
const res = await fetch('/api/generate', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ prompt }) });
if (res.status === 401) await fetch('/api/auth/refresh');
return await fetch('/api/generate', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ prompt }) });
```
Kevin: can we also add a small integration test to the eval-harness that deploys the starter to a disposable preview org and asserts a first-request success? keep it optional to avoid flakiness.
Sam: I'll add a CI job template `ci/vercel-preview-smoke.yml` that teams can opt into. I'll also add guidance in the devex playbook for when to enable it.
Eli: once patch is ready I'll include a changelog entry and bump the starter's dependency in the starter repo with a migration note.
Pranav: thanks. marking this P2 for release cadence but P0 for onboarding impact. adding steps in the issue for reproducing and for the temporary README change.
DevEx Bot: Reminder: tag security for review if refresh flow changes `origin` handling.
Maria: will do. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
